name: Samvardhana Mother
about: Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd. is a leading global supplier to the automotive industry, providing an extensive range of products such as electrical distribution systems, rearview mirrors, bumpers, and interior and exterior modules. With a presence in over 41 countries, the company serves many of the world’s top automotive manufacturers, delivering high-quality, innovative solutions that enhance vehicle performance and aesthetics. Its diversified product portfolio and global manufacturing network allow it to meet the varying demands of the automotive sector. The company focuses on sustainability, innovation, and customer satisfaction, helping automotive brands improve safety, efficiency, and design across their vehicles.
